name: Thandi Chandra
summary: Analytically driven Principal Security Engineer with 17 years of experience securing complex cloud infrastructures and payment ecosystems. Proven track record of designing zero-trust architectures, automating compliance pipelines, and leading incident response teams. Expert in mathematical cryptography and hands-on secure systems engineering.

experience.title: Principal Security Engineer
experience.description: Spearheaded the architecture of a zero-trust network infrastructure across 400+ microservices on AWS, reducing the internal attack surface by 70%. Implemented automated compliance monitoring via Terraform and Python, cutting annual audit prep time from 3 weeks to 2 days. Led a cross-functional incident response team of 12 engineers, maintaining a mean time to resolution (MTTR) under 15 minutes for critical events.

experience.title: Senior Security Engineer
experience.description: Designed and integrated secure CI/CD pipelines utilizing Docker and Linux hardening techniques, scanning 100% of production container images and blocking 40+ high-severity vulnerabilities prior to deployment. Collaborated with 5 product squads to enforce secure coding practices, reducing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities in shipped code by 65%. Engineered a real-time SIEM pipeline handling 1.2 TB of security events daily.

experience.title: Security Engineer
experience.description: Owned the application security program auditing and securing APIs processing 5M+ monthly appointments. Developed custom Python-based static analysis tools integrated into development environments, capturing security regressions with a 92% accuracy rate. Maintained hardened Linux operating systems across production environments, decreasing security patch drift to under 2%.
